_comment: EdgeVitals 3.5 endpoint-integrity baseline: what the bank approved on a known-good terminal.
Its SHA-256 is written into every integrity baseline record (baseline_hash), so a quiet edit is visible.
Generate on a clean terminal: edgevitals.exe --fim-baseline > integrity-baseline.json, then review and commit.
A missing or rejected file falls back to the strict built-in default (nothing approved), so findings can only get louder.
_note_files: Watched files. A bare string = watch and report changes once a hash is pinned; an object {path, sha256, required} pins the approved hash. sha256 empty = report INFO (watched, not pinned) until pinned. required false = absence is INFO not FAIL. Paths are examples; set the real install paths and pin the hashes from the clean build.
_note_persist: Approved persistence (autostart, services, tasks). Tokens are kind:name (any target) or kind:name:target; a trailing * is a prefix. kind is run | run_once | service | task. target is the exe file name only. Generate from the clean terminal and keep only what the bank authorises.
